Api._comment: Defaults match Dotnetable.API's dev launchSettings. Override per machine in localsettings.json (gitignored) — put the real WebsiteKey (the site's AuthCode from Admin -> Website API Key) there.

Theme._comment: Fallback when the API is unreachable. Live active theme comes from api/theme/active (Admin → Themes).

Cache._comment: Short TTL for cached public content reads (menu/categories/pages/posts) — the only staleness bound, since this Web instance isn't notified when Admin/API's content changes.

Hosting._comment: Set true only when this app really sits behind a reverse proxy that rewrites X-Forwarded-For. It makes rate limiting and logging use the real client IP; enabling it without a proxy lets a client forge its own IP.

DataProtection._comment: Directory holding the data-protection key ring. Must survive restarts and be SHARED by every instance of this app, or every deploy signs everyone out. Default: App_Data/keys under the content root.
